capabilities: Connect to a Memos instance and browse memos as editable cards
Create, edit, delete, and set visibility for memos with live Markdown preview
Clip web pages by URL and summarize them with a local OpenAI-compatible LLM
Clip the current browser page via a companion Chromium extension
disambiguation: Not a card view for vault notes; it manages records on an external Memos server.
extras: Desktop-only (uses Electron APIs for clipping); requires manual build from source (npm install, copy dist files); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view, create, or edit memos stored on a Memos server from inside the app.

relations.evidence: Desktop Obsidian plugin that connects to a Memos instance and shows memos as editable cards.
summarize them with a local OpenAI-compatible LLM

summary: Desktop plugin that connects to a Memos instance and manages memos as editable cards, with web clipping and local LLM summarization.
